body.query: source=logs-app | where @timestamp>'2020-01-01T10:00:00.000Z' and @timestamp<'2020-01-01T10:30:00.000Z' | where match(message, 'abort aborted aborting backpressure broken conflict corrupt corrupted crash crashed critical deadlock degraded denied disk_full err error exception expired failed failure fatal forbidden insufficient invalid malformed mismatch missing overflow panic retrying severe stale throttled timeout unauthorized underflow unexpected unprocessable unusual violation') | head 10000 | fields message | patterns message method=brain mode=aggregation max_sample_count=5 variable_count_threshold=3 | fields patterns_field, pattern_count, sample_logs | sort -pattern_count | head 5
